summary: This program tracks a coffee shop order by checking a status number and printing the matching message. A switch statement compares the value of status against each case and runs the block that matches, or the default block when nothing matches.

lines.text: This is the single value the switch will evaluate. Change it to 1, 3, or something like 9 and rerun to see each branch, including the default, take over.
The switch takes one expression and compares it against each case label in turn, which is tidier than a long chain of else-if tests when you are matching a variable against fixed values.
Without break, execution falls through into the following case blocks and prints their messages too. The break exits the switch immediately, so only the matching status message appears.
The default block is the backup for any value that no case matched, such as an unknown or errored order. It is last, so it needs no break.
